title: Fluid Transformers and Creative Analogies: Exploring Large Language Models’ Capacity for Augmenting Cross-Domain Analogical Creativity

bias_targets.methodology: Manual review of 108 LLM-generated analogies by five human screeners from diverse demographic backgrounds who independently flagged outputs as potentially harmful or biased and provided qualitative descriptive comments.
